name: ernie_turbo_t2i
description: ERNIE-Image Turbo text-to-image (Comfy-Org template image_ernie_image_turbo, prompt enhancer off): Ministral 3 3B encoder (CLIPLoader type flux2), EmptyFlux2LatentImage, KSampler 8 steps cfg 1 euler/simple, zeroed negative. Only a bf16 build (16 GB) is published; UNETLoader casts it to fp8_e4m3fn on load so it fits beside the encoder on a 20 GB card. ERNIE's own flux2-vae copy is installed as flux2-vae-ernie.safetensors. Apache-2.0.

requires.assumed: weight_dtype fp8_e4m3fn is our change (the template loads default); compare against 'default' once on the server. The VAE is renamed on disk because ERNIE's flux2-vae.safetensors is not byte-identical to the FLUX.2 klein one
